task_spec.description: go.opentelemetry.io/otel's global TracerProvider (and, confirmed independently 5 days later for the sibling MeterProvider mechanism during the GenAI-metrics RFC) only meaningfully re-delegates a given already-obtained Tracer/Meter handle's FIRST real provider. This is a real, external SDK behavior, not a Kelvran bug -- but it is load-bearing for how every OTel-swap-based test in this codebase must be written: a shared recorder installed exactly once (typically in a package's own TestMain), never a fresh provider swapped in per-test, is the only pattern that actually works. Naive per-test provider-swapping (the first pass's own first attempt) silently produced spans for test 1 only, with every subsequent test's own swapped-in provider seeing zero spans -- a real, previously-undiscovered assumption gap the test itself caught.
